sectors.name: Technology
themes: US AI-infrastructure capex is a durable driver, with PLTR and IT signaling enterprise software monetization of AI models is now mainstream, not experimental.

Indonesia's tech sector lacks listed pure-plays and remains hostage to macro liquidity; global tech beta must be captured via US listings, not local indices.
sectors.ai: Buy US-listed tech exposure via SGOV-hedged instruments or large-cap ADRs; Indonesia tech remains a laggard with no liquid pure-play. PLTR, ZBRA, and IT confirm AI-infrastructure and data-analytics demand is accelerating, not peaking. Rotate into US semis (ARM, MRVL) and storage (SNDK) for Q3 earnings momentum; ignore ID tech until local unicorn IPOs materialize.

themes: Indonesia's nickel downstreaming policy continues to drive vertically integrated renewable and EV supply chain investments, benefiting TOBA's battery materials segment.

Domestic EV adoption is accelerating in Indonesia, with VKTR's commercial vehicle focus capitalizing on fleet electrification mandates and infrastructure buildout.
sectors.ai: Buy the pullback in Indonesian renewables, led by TOBA and VKTR, as the sector's +0.97% local outperformance signals domestic policy tailwinds. US solar names (SEDG, ENPH, FSLR) confirm global demand strength. Accumulate TOBA for nickel-integrated EV battery exposure and VKTR for commercial EV adoption, targeting 15% upside over 3 months.
